personality_one_liner: A premium yet gamified and energetic commerce experience, blending playful ticket-stub motifs with refined, calm browsing.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. Elements shouldn't feel cramped. Padding inside cards is md or lg. Vertical rhythm should be obvious.

do's: Apply glass to sticky bottom CTAs on the Competition Detail screen
Apply glass to the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Apply to feature overlays like 'Ending Soon' floating pills over images
dont's: Never blur body content or list rows
Don't stack glass on top of glass

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase featured draws and energetic gamified elements to drive immediate entry.

states.loading: Skeleton grids and a subtle pulsing purple logo
states.empty: No active draws? Show a playful 'Cooking up new prizes' ticket stub illustration
states.error: Failed to load draws. Show a broken ticket stub with a retry button

screens.layout: Top header with user balance/avatar. Hero section displaying large floating gift card images over a radial gradient background with a primary CTA. Followed by a horizontal 'Live Winners' ticker. Below that, a 2-col grid of 'Featured Pools' using rounded cards, ending with Trust Pillars.

screens.name: Browse
screens.purpose: Allow users to filter, sort, and discover all active gift card pools.

states.empty: No pools found for this category. Show an empty ticket illustration.
states.error: Error message with a primary retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with horizontal scrollable category chips (Gift Cards, Gaming, etc.) and a Sort dropdown pill. Below is a padded 2-col grid of competition cards.

screens.name: Competition Detail
screens.purpose: Persuade the user to enter the draw by showing the prize value, countdown urgency, and easy quantity selection.

states.loading: Full screen skeleton focusing on the large hero image area.
states.error: Failed to fetch details. Standard error state.

screens.layout: Massive top half devoted to a floating gift card visual over a radial-gradient brand-color background. Top right corner has a tier badge (Micro/Volume/Mega). Below the image: Prize Title, Countdown timer with 4 animated flip boxes (DD:HH:MM:SS), and a thick progress bar (tickets sold). A sticky bottom CTA fixed to the bottom holding the ticket quantity selector (+/- slider) and the 'Enter Draw - $X' primary button with a ticket-notch visual shape.

screens.name: Checkout
screens.purpose: Confirm the entry details and redirect to Gumroad for payment securely.
screens.layout: Clean summary card: item, quantity, processing fee, total. Big Gumroad redirect button at the bottom. Trust icons below the button.

screens.name: Winners
screens.purpose: Provide social proof and transparency with RANDOM.ORG verified draws.

states.empty: No winners yet. 'First draw happens soon!'

screens.layout: Feed of recent winners (avatar, prize, username). A secondary tab/section showing a data-table-like list of verified draws with their RANDOM.ORG serial numbers.

screens.name: Account & My Entries
screens.purpose: User management and historical entry tracking.

states.empty: No entries yet. 'Get your first ticket!'

screens.layout: Header with avatar and display name. 'My Entries' list showing past pools entered, status (Won/Lost/Pending), and ticket count. Sign out button at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the locked palette: Purple (#6D28D9), Gold (#F59E0B), Shell (#2D1B69), BG (#FAF8FF), Border (#E8DEFF), Text (#1A0A2E).
Font weights MUST be capped at 500 max per core rules, even though the user requested 800-900. Use Outfit for display headings to maintain the thick/playful feel, and Figtree for body text.
Component Shape Language: Use 16-20px rounded cards. Incorporate 'ticket-stub' notches (cutout semi-circles on the left/right edges) on primary CTAs and badges to deliver the gamified raffle feel.

Competition Card Component: Requires an image area with a radial gradient background (using brand colors), a floating gift card image on top, tier badges (MICRO, VOLUME, MEGA) mapped to the defined colors, and a thick progress bar representing tickets sold.
Motion: Ensure countdown timers use a 4-box layout with flip animations. Integrate a confetti burst effect on successful checkout/entry.

Layout Rules: Competition Detail needs a sticky bottom CTA container housing the ticket quantity selector (+/- or slider), total price, and 'Enter draw' button. Ensure proper safe-area padding below it.
Apply `expo-glass-effect` to the sticky bottom CTA container in the Detail screen to let the scrollable description blur underneath.
